== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill on party members that are being attacked, and on party members below 70% [[health]]. 
* They will cast Weapon of Warding to overwrite non-defensive weapon spells when the target's health is at critical levels, and are more cautious about attacking while under its effects (possibly due to the [[Weapon of Warding (PvP)|PvP version]]'s ''"Ends if target ally attacks"'' function).

== Trivia ==
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Weapon of Warding/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Weapon of Warding (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
